as_told.title: The Typhoon submarine appears as McMoneagle described it

plain: A man named Paul Smith, who speaks about a US psychic spy program, tells of Joe McMoneagle, a remote viewer, meaning someone who tries to describe faraway places with the mind alone. According to Smith, in 1979 McMoneagle described a Russian shipyard on the White Sea, and eight months after those sessions the Russians floated out the Typhoon, the biggest submarine ever built, with its missile tubes placed as described. Smith tells it on two podcast episodes as evidence that the mind can see things it has no ordinary way to know.
